title: Compose Companion IssueStack and detail reads

gates.name: companion_browser
gates.command: cd frontend && npm run test:e2e -- tests/e2e/companion-governance.spec.ts

verify: Independent browser verification covers only IssueStack/detail, attention, proposals, DecisionRecords, conclusion, pagination/order, retained archive, literal text, and absence of command capability.
evidence_required: FT-016-AC-029 RED: no browser Companion IssueStack/detail consumer exists; GREEN: exact active and retained-authorized projections render in canonical order with literal presentation text while denied/inconsistent cases fail safely and no run/decision/close request is emitted; decisive comparison: protected responses versus DOM plus request allowlist; artifact: Companion read evidence under .tasks/TASK-089-T3-FT-016-W3/.
purpose: Make the typed Companion governance projection visible without turning UI text or retained records into Safety, Plant, Task, or provider authority.
success_outcome: Authorized users can read exact IssueStack/detail, attention, proposal, DecisionRecord, and conclusion projections while denied/retained paths remain safe and no Companion command is emitted.
anti_goals: Do not invoke Companion, decide a proposal, close an issue, post raw UI text, create Safety approval, mutate Plant state, or create action_task.
Do not copy proposal/rationale/chat into agent context or expose a retained command capability.

forbidden_scope: backend Companion, DecisionRecord, Task, Safety, Bus, or Plant authority
arbitrary prompt/chat submission and production fake/fallback
raw governance text in agent context
stop_conditions: The UI requires a Companion command outside Companion Governance HTTP.
The path cannot distinguish governance decision from Safety approval or keep UI text out of provider input.

constraints: Primary owner is Operator PWA; Companion Governance owns issues, proposals, DecisionRecords, effects, and invocation input.
Reads use only the protected IssueStack/detail routes and expose no command control in retained mode.
invariants: DecisionRecord presentation is not Safety Gate approval and cannot mutate Plant or create action_task.
UI text/proposal/rationale remains presentation data and never becomes agent fact or arbitrary provider input.
verification_targets: FT-016-AC-029: exact IssueStack/detail shapes, ordering, continuation, retained access, literal text, and zero command request.
T3 harm proof uses isolated issues/proposals and confirms denied/inconsistent/retained reads leave no unauthorized effect.
